findings.title: Preserve stock currency and rate basis
findings.observed: A retained request explicitly specified USD and a line total; the assistant filled a numeric unit rate without currency. The current assistant form-fill catalog/adapter and Gateway tool schemas still lack currency. The native UI has currency controls, but the Hub agent action strips currency and bypasses the native API conversion path.
findings.evidence: Actual canonical route probes: USD preview omits currency; confirmed draft passes raw rate 100 with no currency/FX metadata. The existing shared helper produces 375 from the same synthetic USD rate at synthetic FX 3.75. No production valuation was tested.
findings.action: Thread explicit currency and unit/line-total basis through the form, Gateway tool, preview and action. Reuse native conversion and persist FX provenance; keep draft creation separate from posting.
findings.acceptance: USD and PEN; unit and line totals; missing FX; UI already in total mode; preserved earlier draft lines; preview/commit parity. Unsupported currency must be explicit.
findings.prior: Additional finding; adjacent to F06/F07 action closure.
findings.trace: c6e6da527369, physical lines 20-23; follow-up fe0caf8192ea 46-47. Private identifiers retained only in the evidence ledger.

findings.title: Make booking rescheduling atomic and validated
findings.observed: Create-booking preflight is fixed, but reschedule still returns a syntax-only preview, creates a replacement, then independently cancels the original. An existing native transactional reschedule service now exists.
findings.evidence: Five actual-route synthetic scenarios reproduced a successful create followed by cancellation failure, leaving a simulated replacement. Replay reaches create again. Authority denial and unavailable-slot controls pass. Native slot conflicts can prevent a particular duplicate; this is not a production duplicate claim.
findings.action: Specify move-versus-replacement semantics, use the appropriate atomic native service, validate original references, and return an idempotent effect receipt. Preview must describe the same effect as commit.
findings.acceptance: Failure between effects; missing/foreign original; same-resource overlapping move; invalid contact; linked payments/packages/series; retries after uncertain delivery.
findings.prior: Additional source finding adjacent to C03/F07, not a recurrence of the fixed create preview.

findings.title: Reconcile summaries against received booking rows
findings.observed: A retained appointment answer reports 10 bookings and 3 no-shows after receiving 11 unique booking IDs and 4 no-shows, all within the requested local day. One already-returned slot disappears from the summary.
findings.evidence: A deterministic private receipt check deduplicates overlapping tool responses, verifies consistent duplicate IDs and local-day bounds, then compares the terminal aggregate. This proves summarization loss in that trace, not a current model failure or database population completeness.
findings.action: Compute and reconcile authoritative total/status aggregates, deduplicate by booking ID, keep scope/coverage explicit, and make totals agree with displayed rows. Count people only from stable authorized identity, never attendee display labels.
findings.acceptance: Overlapping result windows; multiple bookings per contact; equal display names; all statuses; repeated slots; capped data. Preserve current exact-count/truncation contracts.
findings.prior: Additional semantic finding distinct from C04 silent truncation and F01 date selection.
findings.trace: e16518e73706 request line43; tool receipts45/46/48/49/51/52/54/56/58; final59.

findings.title: Adopt the reviewed Gateway guardrails
findings.observed: Fresh Gateway DEV is byte-for-byte the November 6 audit base. Reviewed memory/onboarding/DSML/redaction corrections have not entered DEV or the reviewed release files.
findings.evidence: Current source still supplies at most two messages to a four-message memory threshold; extraction capacity lacks reservation; bootstrap conflicts with ordinary-task guidance. Five sanitizer probes reproduce DSML and supported-secret gaps plus two passing controls.
findings.action: Recover and qualify the existing candidate commits and gates. Do not create a parallel implementation or assume the open production promotion PR includes these local corrections.
findings.acceptance: Exact candidate source, independent review, focused and full checks, actual CI, applicable human gates, immutable deployed identity and runtime checks.

findings.title: Make completion depend on durable receipts
findings.observed: Error metadata, semantic isError and unknown-write stopping exist. Durable extracted-memory dispatch still returns void and swallows sink failures, so extraction telemetry does not prove storage.
findings.evidence: Current memory-service and memory-sink source. Open Gateway PR367 already covers fetch deadlines/in-flight protection but is unmerged and does not supply durable acknowledgment/idempotency.
findings.action: Separate extracted, queued, persisted and confirmed states; add durable acknowledgment and idempotency. Preserve current honest recovery and explicit-write preview/confirm contracts.
findings.acceptance: Sink failure; partial delivery; timeout after commit; duplicate retry; explicit remember recovery. No saved claim from a rejected or unknown receipt.

findings.title: Rank the metric the user requested
findings.observed: Finance selects top 15 invoice items by revenue. Returned quantities describe that revenue-selected subset; per-service cost/margin is absent. A volume winner can be excluded.
findings.evidence: Canonical finance route and service. This supports the contract gap behind the historical price-for-margin failure, not a new production reasoning incident.
findings.action: Expose explicit quantity/revenue/margin rankings with population, coverage, currency, period, cost provenance and tie/truncation semantics. Return unavailable when costs are insufficient.
findings.acceptance: Low-price quantity winner outside revenue top15; missing cost; POS-only sales; overlapping sources; ties at cap; sensitive-field masking.

findings.title: Complete booking prerequisite discovery
findings.observed: Booking creation needs eventTypeId/resource context, while catalog and POS reads return productId without a guaranteed service/event mapping. No dedicated typed event/resource/slot read was found.
findings.evidence: Canonical gateway query inventory, booking-create schema, catalog and POS projections. Other custom tool or form paths may exist; not every booking is claimed impossible.
findings.action: Provide permission-scoped service/event mappings, eligible resources, local timezone and availability reads. Preserve assignment and module authorization.
findings.acceptance: Named-service booking using only authorized typed tools; ambiguous names; inactive/foreign resources; no slots; explicit access denial.
findings.prior: F07; create preflight C03 already fixed.

findings.title: Reconcile interruptions after a run is claimed
findings.observed: Lost-ack pending-run recovery is merged, but reconnect still revokes claimed runs; a result arriving after binding invalidation is discarded.
findings.evidence: PR643 and canonical accepted-runs/runner source. This limit is already documented and is not a reason to undo pending-run recovery.
findings.action: Expose interrupted/unknown effect state and reconcile persisted receipts without automatically replaying a possibly committed write.
findings.acceptance: Reconnect during read, after commit before receipt, and across user/org/host identity change; no duplicate replay.
findings.prior: Existing November8 resume proposal and PR643.

findings.title: Keep memory provenance and business tool scope explicit
findings.observed: Retained workshop speculation/heartbeat filler appears in injected memory. Extraction receives role/content without effect-receipt provenance. Policy machinery exists, but live business-profile restrictions could not be inspected.
findings.evidence: Retained traces and canonical extraction/tool-policy contracts. Causal storage path and current tenant configuration remain unproven.
findings.action: Distinguish user facts, plans, peer claims and confirmed effects; suppress duplicate filler and bound workshop goals. Apply existing business-tool policies and verify enforcement.
findings.acceptance: Unexecuted promise; peer opinion; duplicate heartbeat; explicit user correction; permitted business read versus unnecessary environment enumeration.
findings.prior: F09/F12. No historical credential rotation or new authority inferred.

findings.title: Read Minion release notes on demand
findings.observed: An October12 changelog request received upstream OpenClaw notes and an unsupported installed-version claim. Current changelog guidance explicitly forbids that substitution, but its existing TODO says actual release notes are not supplied.
findings.evidence: Current changelog manifest and its regression assertion; existing open-end3 of the JEV/context-router proposal. No current recurrence was tested.
findings.action: Complete the existing on-demand Hub release-notes read, retaining product/source identity and separate runtime-version receipts. Do not re-file missing guidance.
findings.acceptance: Current Minion page with upstream distractors; notes unavailable; installed version unknown; user asks for response rather than an upgrade.
findings.prior: Historical additional trace, partly addressed; existing October12 proposal owns data-read gap.
